data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $124,103,000 (2023: $106,371,000) is a deterioration of $9,063,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2023: deterioration $10,197,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross strengthening of prior year claims reserves of $15.642m (gross) at 31 December 2024 (a net deterioration cited of $9.063m). The movement reflects adverse claims development and an increase in reserves driven by IBNR recalibration and inflationary pressures. The syndicate's portfolio is predominantly US motor liability (Delivery and Rideshare), which is the primary exposure area for these reserve movements.
